title.zh: 将奎松省古马卡市镇伊巴邦巴诺特村更名为吉特南村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Ibabang Banot, Municipality of Gumaca, Province of Quezon, to Gitnang Barrio
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Ibabang Banot, Municipality of Gumaca, Province of Quezon, to Gitnang Barrio
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Ibabang Banot, Thị trấn Gumaca, Tỉnh Quezon thành Gitnang Barrio
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Ibabang Banot, เทศบาล Gumaca, จังหวัด Quezon เป็น Gitnang Barrio
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Ibabang Banot, Kotamadya Gumaca, Provinsi Quezon menjadi Gitnang Barrio
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Ibabang Banot, Perbandaran Gumaca, Wilayah Quezon menjadi Gitnang Barrio

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2547_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Ibabang Banot, Municipality of Gumaca, Province of Quezon, is hereby changed to Gitnang Barrio.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
